items.raw_excerpt: “If you’re eating duck rice (from the neighbouring stall), I’m not cooking for you,” says eccentric hawker Danny Lee, whose notoriously pricey Geylang zi char stall has no menu and unwritten rules.
items.summary_en: Danny Lee runs a famous zi char stall in Geylang, Singapore, known for its crab bee hoon. He has no menu and enforces strict unwritten rules, like refusing to cook for customers who eat rival hawker food. His prices are high but fans keep coming back.
items.summary_ko: 대니 리는 싱가포르 게일랑의 유명한 지차 가게를 운영하며, 게살 쌀국수로 유명하다. 그는 메뉴판 없이 영업하며, 옆집 콕포를 먹은 손님에게는 요리하지 않는다는 엄격한 규칙을 고수한다. 높은 가격에도 팬들은 여전히 찾는다.
items.title_en: A famous hawker has strict rules for ordering his crab bee hoon
items.title_ko: 유명 콕포 장사꾼, 게일랑에서 규칙 까다롭게 지키며 게살 쌀국수 제공
items.title_original: This Sin Huat Eating House hawker has strict rules for ordering his famous crab bee hoon

items.raw_excerpt: Eve Gaut has brought Stavros and Nikos from Crete to Shropshire after working with local rescuers.
items.summary_en: Eve Gaut fell in love with two stray cats while on holiday in Crete. She worked with local rescuers to bring them home to Shropshire, England.

items.raw_excerpt: A small community in rural Hawke's Bay is working hard to restore a large area of precious native bush that's home to one of New Zealand's largest Totara trees, a colony of threatened long tail bats and a rare native mistletoe.
items.summary_en: A small community in rural Hawke's Bay is working to restore a large area of native bush. The area is home to one of New Zealand's largest Totara trees, a colony of threatened long-tailed bats, and a rare native mistletoe. The restoration project helps protect these precious native species.
items.summary_ko: Hawke's Bay 농촌 지역의 작은 공동체가 자생 수풀 복원 작업을 진행하고 있습니다. 이 지역은 뉴질랜드에서 가장 큰 Totara 나무 중 하나와 멸종 위기에 처한 긴꼬리 박쥐 군락, 그리고 희귀한 자생 겨우살이의 서식지입니다. 복원 사업은 이 귀중한 자생 종의 보호에 기여하고 있습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Tamil Nadu raises milk procurement price to ₹44 per litre, compensating cooperatives amid rising input costs.
items.summary_en: The Indian state of Tamil Nadu has increased the price it pays dairy cooperatives for raw milk to ₹44 per litre. The move is designed to compensate dairy cooperatives facing higher production costs. It directly affects local dairy farmers across the state.

items.title_en: Tamil Nadu raises milk procurement price to ₹44 per litre

items.summary_en: A young man named Danny used his digger to fight a wildfire threatening Hollywood-on-Sea in Cornwall. He worked for two hours creating fire breaks despite his family's concerns. His brave efforts helped divert the blaze and protect the village.

items.summary_en: The Local France shares a common French expression. 'Une autre paire de manches' means another matter or another story. The phrase plays on the idea of extra sleeves during a heatwave.

items.raw_excerpt: Vienna has added free public charging points to four parks, with another on the way. And they aren't the only places where you can top up your battery outdoors.
items.summary_en: Vienna has installed free public charging points in four parks, with more on the way. Visitors can charge their phones outdoors while enjoying the park. The city aims to make parks more convenient for everyone.

items.summary_en: A Kerala state minister criticized a religious leader's order that bans women from attending public gatherings. She called the ban a step backward for gender equality in India. The issue has sparked debate about women's rights in the region.

items.raw_excerpt: Kanjikuzhi in Kerala has built a local vegetable-growing system that relies on kitchen gardens, backyards and pots rather than large farms. Reported by Scroll, the community’s chemical-free approach has reduced dependence on outside supply and offers a practical model of food self-reliance. The village’s experience also points to a wider economic lesson for India: resilience can be built through small, distributed efforts that lower exposure to price shocks and chemical inputs.
items.summary_en: People in Kanjikuzhi, Kerala grow vegetables in kitchen gardens, backyards, and pots. They do not use chemicals, so they depend less on outside supply. The village shows how small local efforts can build food self-reliance.
items.summary_ko: 케랄라의 칸지쿠지 사람들은 큰 농장 대신 주방 정원과 마당, 화분에서 채소를 재배합니다. 화학약품 없이 기르는 이 방식 덕분에 외부 공급 의존도가 줄었습니다. 이 마을의 경험은 작은 분산 노력으로도 식량 자급과 물가 충격 대응을 강화할 수 있음을 보여줍니다.
items.title_en: A Kerala village grows its own food in backyards
items.title_ko: 케랄라 마을이 텃밭에서 직접 식량을 키워요
items.title_original: How a Kerala village turned backyard growing into food self-reliance - ET Chemicals

items.raw_excerpt: A North Jutland homeowner digging for a new patio uncovered the largest silver Viking treasure ever discovered in Denmark, with more 18.5 kilograms of silver found so far, according to the museum leading the excavation.
items.summary_en: A gardener in North Jutland uncovered Denmark's largest Viking silver treasure while digging a new patio. More than 18.5 kilograms of silver have been found so far. The museum leading the excavation says it is the biggest Viking hoard ever discovered in the country.
items.summary_ko: 덴마크 북 Atatür크 지역의 한 주택주인이 새 테라스를 파던 중 덴마크 역사상 최대 규모의 바이킹 은 보물을 발견했습니다. 현재까지 18.5kg 이상의 은이 출토되었으며, 발굴을 이끄는 박물관은 이것이 덴마크에서 발견된 역대 최대 바이킹 보물 hoard라고 밝혔습니다.
items.title_en: Homeowner finds Denmark's largest Viking silver hoard while digging patio
items.title_ko: 덴마크에서 주택주인, 테라스 파던 중 최대 바이킹 은 보물 발견

items.raw_excerpt: The cabinet has formally apologised to children who have had to live in secure youth care facilities, saying the institutions were unsafe and damaging to those kept there. “It was not and is not your fault. Nothing you went through in secure youth care was your own doing,” youth minister Mirjam Sterk said during a ceremony on Saturday. Over the past twenty years, more than 20,000 people have been kept in gesloten jeugdzorg, restricted residential facilities for children who cannot...
items.summary_en: The Dutch cabinet has formally apologised to over 20,000 people who lived in secure youth care facilities over the past twenty years. The government said these institutions were unsafe and harmful. Youth minister Mirjam Sterk told those affected that it was not their fault.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 정부는 지난 20년간 보호 청소년 시설에 머물렀던 2만 명 이상의 사람들에게 공식 사과했다. 정부는 해당 시설들이 안전하지 않았으며 입소자들에게 유해했다고 인정했다. 청소년부 장관 미르잠 스테르크는 피해자들에게 이것은 너희 잘못이 아니라고 말했다.
items.title_en: Dutch government apologises to youth in secure care facilities

items.raw_excerpt: International students in the Netherlands more than pay for themselves over their lifetimes, and capping their number would do little to ease the housing shortage, according to new research by the government’s economic policy analysis bureau CPB. The money the government spends on them – student grants, healthcare, social security – is on average more than recouped, the CPB said, mainly because a growing share stay after graduating and pay tax. More international students do add to housing press
items.summary_en: New research shows international students in the Netherlands pay for themselves over their lifetimes. The government spends money on grants and services, but most students stay after graduating and pay taxes. Limiting student numbers would do little to fix the housing shortage.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 정부 경제 분석 기관의 새 연구에 따르면, 외국 유학생은 일생 동안 정부 지출보다 더 많은 경제적 기여를 한다. 많은 유학생이 졸업 후 네덜란드에 남아 세금을 내기 때문이다. 유학생 수를 제한해도 주택 부족 해결에는 큰 도움이 되지 않는 것으로 나타났다.
items.title_en: Foreign students good for Dutch economy, study finds

items.title_original: Foreign students beneficial to Dutch economy, CPB says
